zin_variety_end_feuds = {
	# V6: the feuds end within ninety days (zin_variety.2), whoever holds the field.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_1 }
		clr_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_1
		cancel_border_war = {
			attacker = global.zin_sv_feud_1_a
			defender = global.zin_sv_feud_1_b
			dont_fire_events = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_2 }
		clr_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_2
		cancel_border_war = {
			attacker = global.zin_sv_feud_2_a
			defender = global.zin_sv_feud_2_b
			dont_fire_events = yes
		}
	}
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding } clr_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
}
zin_variety_start_feud_1 = {
	# V6, feud 1: two bordering AI realms of a feud group, a border state of each, and a border war with no land to change hands.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_t_found = 0 }
	random_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_variety_feud_ready = yes
			any_neighbor_country = {
				zin_variety_feud_ready = yes
				zin_variety_same_feud_group = yes
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = zin_variety_feud_a
		random_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_variety_feud_ready = yes
				zin_variety_same_feud_group = yes
			}
			save_event_target_as = zin_variety_feud_b
			set_temp_variable = { zin_t_found = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_t_found = 1 } }
		event_target:zin_variety_feud_b = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = event_target:zin_variety_feud_a } }
				set_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark
				set_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_1_b = THIS }
			}
		}
		event_target:zin_variety_feud_a = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { any_neighbor_state = { has_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_1_a = THIS }
			}
		}
		every_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark } clr_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_1_a > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_1_b > 0 }
			}
			event_target:zin_variety_feud_a = { set_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
			event_target:zin_variety_feud_b = { set_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
			set_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_1
			start_border_war = {
				change_state_after_war = no
				combat_width = 40
				minimum_duration_in_days = 14
				attacker = {
					state = global.zin_sv_feud_1_a
					num_provinces = 2
				}
				defender = {
					state = global.zin_sv_feud_1_b
					num_provinces = 2
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_variety.2 days = 90 }
		}
	}
}

		event_target:zin_variety_feud_b = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = event_target:zin_variety_feud_a } }
				set_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark
				set_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_2_b = THIS }
			}
		}
		event_target:zin_variety_feud_a = {
			random_owned_state = {
				limit = { any_neighbor_state = { has_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark } }
				set_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_2_a = THIS }
			}
		}
		every_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark } clr_state_flag = zin_variety_feud_mark }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_2_a > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.zin_sv_feud_2_b > 0 }
			}
			event_target:zin_variety_feud_a = { set_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
			event_target:zin_variety_feud_b = { set_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
			set_global_flag = zin_variety_feud_2
			start_border_war = {
				change_state_after_war = no
				combat_width = 40
				minimum_duration_in_days = 14
				attacker = {
					state = global.zin_sv_feud_2_a
					num_provinces = 2
				}
				defender = {
					state = global.zin_sv_feud_2_b
					num_provinces = 2
				}
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_variety.2 days = 90 }
		}
	}
}
zin_variety_temper_new_ruler = {
	# Realm life (G1): a new ruler of an AI realm (any realm under FULL, Q-92) may have a temper, as at the start, when the start variety is not off.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_start_variety_drawn
			OR = {
				is_ai = yes
				has_global_flag = zin_start_variety_full
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			50 = { }
			50 = { zin_variety_add_temper = yes }
		}
	}
}
